relations.rationale: Leo setting down chairs near the entrance establishes the chairs' presence, making it plausible they later pack them up together.
Dev being slightly taller than Ben is a height fact but doesn't indicate whether they cared about height comparisons.
Height difference between Dev and Ben has no bearing on traffic slowing Gus down.
A height comparison between Dev and Ben has no relevance to the group's agreement about the garden's condition.
Dev and Ben's indifference to height comparisons has no bearing on Mina's team membership.
If Mina is on the same team as Leo, and Leo is not on the same team as Dev, these are consistent but the first doesn't directly establish the second, though it's compatible.
If Mina is on Leo's team and Leo is not on Dev's team (implied elsewhere), Mina being on Leo's team supports Mina not being on Dev's team, but this pair alone doesn't establish that link.
Mina's team membership with Leo has no bearing on Gus's arrival order.
Mina being on Leo's team is unrelated to traffic affecting Gus.
Mina's team membership with Leo has no bearing on Dev's shift preference.
Ben arriving after Mina and before Gus are independent arrival facts that are consistent but don't directly imply each other.
Ben's arrival time relative to Mina has no bearing on team membership between Leo and Dev.
Ben's arrival time has no bearing on what the group discussed.
Ben's arrival relative to Mina has no bearing on Mina's team membership relative to Dev.
Ben arriving after Mina but before Gus is consistent with Gus arriving last, supporting that claim.
Ben's arrival time relative to Mina has no bearing on Leo's preference for mornings.
Ben's arrival timing has no bearing on the group's agreement about the garden's condition.
Ben arriving before Gus has no bearing on team membership between Leo and Dev.
Ben's arrival before Gus has no bearing on Mina's team membership relative to Dev.
Ben arriving before Gus directly supports the claim that Gus arrived last, since it establishes Gus after at least one person.
